findings.english_quote: having taken upon yourself the cares of everyone
findings.issue: The passive participle explicitly depicts Clement as loaded or burdened with everyone's cares. The draft shifts the grammatical agency and makes the burden image less explicit.
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “burdened with the cares of everyone.” This proposed replacement requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: τὸ σὲ οἰκονομεῖν ἀναδέξασθαι χάριν οἶδα εἰληφώς, οὐ δεδωκώς
findings.english_quote: Hence I know that, in your undertaking to administer, I have received a favor, not given one.
findings.issue: The infinitival construction leaves the assignment of subject and object unresolved. The notes disclose Clement undertaking administration and the speaker undertaking to have Clement administer, but do not separately examine σέ as the object of οἰκονομεῖν, with the speaker undertaking to direct or make provision for Clement. These analyses materially affect the account of who undertakes what. The independently image-checked print establishes the supplied wording, not the preferred syntactic interpretation.
findings.suggested_revision: Supply separate grammatical and contextual evidence comparing these analyses of the exact Lagarde reading. Expand source_issues to include the object analysis and preserve the uncertainty until adjudicated. If a different reading is proposed, identify its textual evidence separately rather than silently replacing the supplied Greek. Any revised English requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: ἵνα ἕκαστος, ἐπιδικαζόμενος τοῦ πάντας φίλους ἔχειν, αὐτὸν διαλλάττων σώζηται
findings.english_quote: so that each person, pressing his claim to have everyone as friends, may be saved by reconciling him
findings.issue: The draft preserves the pronoun and discloses uncertainty, but the referent of αὐτόν and the relationship expressed by διαλλάττων remain unresolved. Reconciling the presiding leader, reconciling an alienated person, and effecting reconciliation with the referent are materially different interpretations. Disclosure does not resolve this blocking meaning problem.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide separate contextual and grammatical evidence identifying the likely referent and the construction of active διαλλάττων with αὐτόν. Retain the supplied wording and unresolved alternatives meanwhile. The print transcription is already image-checked; this finding does not establish textual corruption. Any more explicit English must undergo fresh review.

findings.issue: The antecedent of αὐτοῦ remains unresolved. Connecting it with the presiding leader rather than another participant in the preceding reconciliation clause changes whose discourse is to be heeded. The existing note honestly discloses this problem but supplies no separate evidence settling it.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide an independently supported contextual account of the pronoun sequence, coordinated with the analysis of αὐτὸν διαλλάττων. Preserve the neutral pronoun and the unresolved source_issues until that evidence is reviewed; do not certify a particular antecedent merely because the English remains ambiguous.

findings.source_quote: Ἀξιῶ σε ἐπὶ πάντων μου τῶν συνπαρόντων ἀδελφῶν, ὅπως ὁπόταν τοῦ ἐνταῦθα (ὡς ἐμοὶ ὀφείλεται) ἀπαλλάξω βίου, σὲ Ἰακώβῳ τῷ ἀδελφῷ τοῦ κυρίου διαπέμψαι ἐν ἐπιτομῇ ἀναγραψάμενον μέχρι καὶ τῶν ἐκ παίδων σου λογισμῶν καὶ ὡς ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς μέχρι τοῦ νῦν συνώδευσάς μοι, ἐπακούων τῶν κατὰ πόλιν ὑπ᾽ ἐμοῦ κηρυχθέντων λόγων τε καὶ πράξεων, ἔπειτα πρὸς τῷ τέλει καὶ τὴν τοῦ θανάτου μου πρόφασιν ὡς προεῖπον δηλῶσαι μὴ ὀκνήσῃς
findings.english_quote: Before all my brothers who are here with me, I charge you: whenever I depart from this life here—as is owed to me—send James, the Lord’s brother, a concise written account, reaching back even to your thoughts from childhood and telling how, from the beginning until now, you have traveled with me, listening to the words and deeds proclaimed by me from city to city. Then, toward the end, do not hesitate also to make known the cause of my death, as I foretold.
findings.issue: The extended construction remains unresolved. The draft attaches “do not hesitate” explicitly only to disclosure of the death's cause. A substantial alternative takes the concluding μὴ ὀκνήσῃς as governing both διαπέμψαι and δηλῶσαι within the request introduced by ὅπως. The function of the resumed σέ and its relationship to ἀναγραψάμενον also require analysis. The existing note acknowledges these difficulties but does not settle the chosen English structure.
findings.suggested_revision: Supply separate grammatical evidence for the relationships among Ἀξιῶ σε, ὅπως, the resumed σέ, both infinitives, and μὴ ὀκνήσῃς. Explicitly compare the current English with a construction beginning “I ask you … not to hesitate to send … and then, toward the end, also to make known …”. Do not adopt that proposal without fresh review. Preserve the supplied Greek; unusual syntax and the image-checked punctuation do not themselves establish corruption.

findings.source_quote: οὐκ ἀμαθὴς ἀνὴρ καὶ ζωοποιοὺς λόγους ἀγνοῶν καὶ ἐκκλησίας κανόνα. οὐκ εἰδὼς τὴν τοῦ διδάσκοντος ἐπιστεύθη καθέδραν
findings.english_quote: after me the teacher’s chair was not entrusted to an unlearned man who is ignorant of life-giving words and does not know the church’s rule
findings.issue: Both negations are represented, but the scope of the first οὐκ across the coordinated description remains unresolved. The draft treats the entire described man as the excluded recipient of the chair. Its source_issues disclose this interpretation without establishing it. The period after κανόνα is an editorial feature of the supplied print, not independent evidence resolving the negation's scope.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide separate syntactic evidence supporting the scope of the first οὐκ and its relationship to the explicitly negated εἰδώς. Preserve both negations and the supplied punctuation in the source record. Retain the unresolved meaning issue rather than harmonizing the passage into an unqualified assertion of the successor's learning.

findings.issue: The expression concerns presentation in principal points or outline. “Arrange under headings” can describe merely organizing otherwise unabridged material and does not adequately express the summarizing force supported by the promised epitome.
findings.suggested_revision: Compare “to present in outline” or “to summarize in its main points,” retaining “the greater part” as the quantity of material treated. Any replacement requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: Κλήμεντος τῶν Πέτρου ἐπιδημίων κηρυγμάτων ἐπιτομή
findings.english_quote: Clement’s Epitome of Peter’s Preachings during His Sojourns.
findings.issue: The adjective ἐπιδημίων directly qualifies κηρυγμάτων, but its contextual force remains unresolved. “During His Sojourns” selects a temporal interpretation rather than the alternative association with visits or a local or public sense. The existing note discloses this blocking title uncertainty; print confirmation does not adjudicate it.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide separate lexical and contextual evidence for ἐπιδήμιος modifying κήρυγμα or comparable activity nouns. Compare the current title with a source-qualified candidate such as “Clement’s Epitome of Peter’s Sojourn-Preachings,” while retaining the alternative senses. Do not substitute wording from another edition or treat any proposed title as accepted before fresh review.
